relationships.counterparty: SB Energy Corp. (lessor) / OpenAI Group PBC affiliate (tenant) - PORTS-Pike Technology Campus, Pike County, Ohio
relationships.status_guess: definitive (8-K Item 1.01 'Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement', signed 2026-08-17); guarantees effective phase by phase from ~FY2029
relationships.summary: Nvidia entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy covering 20-year leases to an OpenAI affiliate for ~4.25 GW IT load; obligation capped at $105B, triggered by OpenAI insolvency default or payment failure; pays shortfall between guaranteed minimum lease value and re-let/sale recoveries; OpenAI reimburses/indemnifies Nvidia; option for ~3.8 GW more; terminates on OpenAI satisfactory credit rating or 20 years. In exchange the site exclusively hosts Nvidia infrastructure. No payments made to date (Q3 FY27 CFO commentary).

headline.wording: aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at $105 billion

funded.wording: To date, we have not made any payments related to our guarantees.

contingent_max.wording: capped at a total of $105 billion; exposure builds as buildings come online

relationships.notes: 8-K calls them 'residual value guaranties' (RV form); economic trigger is tenant default, so GU primary, wrong-way risk specific to OpenAI. Option for ~3.8 GW has no stated amount.
